blurb: Guests board the Olivia Margaret, a 42-foot twin-engine boat approved for 20 passengers, for various tours including sightseeing past Peggy's Cove Lighthouse, puffin and seal watching, deep sea fishing, lighthouse tours, and sunset cruises. Tours operate rain or shine from June through September, with some offerings extending to October. Private charters are available to accommodate specific schedules and group needs.
